verdict.rationale: Gazebo ships ready-made simulated sensors that produce data, optionally with noise, from laser range finders, 2D/3D cameras, IMU and GPS (gazebo-gh-14). Messages flow over Gazebo Transport pub/sub (gazebo-docs-36), and ros_gz connects Gazebo to ROS (gazebo-docs-18, gazebo-docs-6). However, these are simulated sensors rather than drivers for physical hardware, and the evidence never documents which standard message types each sensor publishes or how they map to ROS. missing for 10: drivers for real cameras/lidars/IMUs/GPS, documentation of sensor message types and ROS mapping through ros_gz, independent or hands-on corroboration.
